usage.text:
The first domino tips forward and strikes domino2, starting a chain reaction. Each domino knocks into the next; domino10 starts moving at about 0.66 s. All ten settle by roughly 0.9 s and remain at rest through 6 s.

**The scene meets the brief.** Domino1 finishes approximately 64° from upright—its initial 12° lean plus another 52° of rotation. Dominoes2–9 finish about 64° from upright, and domino10 lies flat at 90°. The expectation checks failed because their wording was unsupported, not because the dominoes failed to fall.
